callouts.text: 1 · Select Code. ONE shared pill appears: Language and Font size are the same rows every shape uses.
2 · Open the ch combobox. Pick a preset row (32/48/64/80) or type 72 in Custom.
3 · Click the selected code body once to enter CodeMirror. Type a line, then drag the lower-right handle and watch the live ch badge.
PASS WHEN · One shared pill drives language, Font size, lines, and preset/custom width; CodeMirror edits in place; a native resize shows live ch.
